title: RISKS OF AI FOUNDATION MODELS IN EDUCATION
findings: The paper does not analyze or make any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on the risks of AI foundation models in education, such as homogenization of learning, increased surveillance, and perpetuation of inequities.
